newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil can grow seven percent with reforms-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil can grow seven percent with reforms-paper.

text.p: Brazil could achieve economic growth of seven percent a year if Congress finally approved a number of structural reforms, a financial newspaper said.

A study by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) in Sao Paulo shows that failure to pass into law the tax, civil service and pension reforms is holding back economic growth at three percent a year, Gazeta Mercantil said.

The study found that by not passing the tax reform Brazil is losing out on 1.5 percent growth, while non-approval of the civil service and pension reforms is costing the country 0.4 and 1.8 percent in economic growth, respectively, Gazeta said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
